Technology & Innovation

Modern Methods, Disciplined Delivery

We apply the right technology to make projects more predictable, transparent and better quality.

PRODIGY CONSTRUCTION LIMITED
Toolkit

The Technologies Behind Our Delivery

The methods listed represent what Prodigy uses in practice — and the site is configurable so the toolkit can be updated as the company's capabilities evolve.

Digital Project Management

Digital tools for planning, tracking, reporting and controlling project delivery.

BIM

Building Information Modelling for coordinated design, clash resolution and asset data.

CAD

Computer-aided drafting and design to engineering standards.

Digital Site Reporting

Structured digital reporting from site to client, faster and more transparent.

Drone Inspections

Aerial surveys, progress capture and site inspection where deployed.

Construction Monitoring

Continuous monitoring of progress, quality and safety performance.

Digital Documentation

Secure document control for drawings, approvals, reports and records.

Project Dashboards

Live dashboards that make programme, cost and risk visible to stakeholders.

Quantity & Cost Management

Digital measurement, cost planning and commercial management.

Modern Construction Equipment

Right-sized, well-maintained plant and equipment matched to each works package.

Data-Driven Decision Making

Evidence-based decisions informed by site, programme and cost data.

Logistics & Plant Control

Disciplined logistics, plant allocation and materials flow planning.

Where a technology is not currently applied by the company, it will be removed from this list rather than overstated.
